definition_facts.channel_edges: center +/- bandwidth/2, lower edge clipped to zero
definition_facts.cnp: noise power integrated over the main channel in the forward path direction
definition_facts.cnd: one Hz channel power rather than mean density over an arbitrary band
definition_facts.cnr: desired channel power over thermal plus phase-noise channel power
definition_facts.first_node_reference: internal source plane, not automatically the delivered input power

implemented_scope.noise_integration: piecewise-linear interpolation of nonnegative W/Hz samples; complete clipped-band coverage required
implemented_scope.desired_signal: explicit already-combined discrete line powers inside inclusive edges
implemented_scope.conversion_network: explicit physical port and incident/outgoing wave; selected desired bins
implemented_scope.zero_ratio: explicit status plus absent dB result

not_yet_validated: path direction and internal source reference mapping
